license.registry: City of Columbus Building and Zoning Services, Citizen Access Portal 'Search for Licensed & Registered Contractors' (Accela)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Business-name searches for 'Inter-Co', 'Inter Co' and 'InterCo' returned 'no results'. A broader 'Inter' search returned 9 licensees (Interstates Inc, Interstate Construction Inc, International Excavating of Ohio, Interstate Sign Company, Intertek PSI and others), none of them Inter-Co. Columbus requires a city license or registration under Chapter 4114 before permits. The likely type for commercial interior work is General Contractor, but the city page does not name toilet partitions, so confirm the scope with BZS. The company may be registered under another legal name. Ask the company for its Columbus license number, or confirm with BZS (614-645-7433). No state license applies in Ohio for this work.
